title: Text of Dombrava's 'Spanish letter' released
summary_full: The text of a letter from Latvian Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) to his Spanish counterpart Fernando Grande-Marlaska – which reportedly was not well received in Madrid – has been published.
